BRAND IDENTITY / PORTFOLIO PROJECT

Pillars Academy

An academy identity connecting learning interfaces with certificates and physical brand materials.

DESIGNER / ODUSINA ISAACDISCIPLINE / BRAND IDENTITYVIEW THE PROJECT GALLERY ↓

Context

The project shows an academy identity in both learning interfaces and physical applications.

Visual direction

A blue mark and wordmark connect the course layouts, certificate, notebook, shirt and tote.

Design decisions

Clear navigation and content panels give the learning dashboard a distinct hierarchy. The same blue identity remains visible on the certificate and merchandise.

Applications

Seven presentations include the overview, learning dashboard, course interface, certificate, notebook, shirt and tote. The screen images are portfolio mockups.
